newsitem.title: USA: G7 backs Russia in Paris Club, WTO - Chubais.
newsitem.headline: G7 backs Russia in Paris Club, WTO - Chubais.

text.p: The Group of Seven Industrialized Countries has given its support to Russia's effort to join the Paris Club and the World Trade Organization, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Sunday.
Chubais said ministers had given "a postive estimation" of the reform process in Russia.
"We are really satisfied by the result of this meeting," Chubais, who is also Russian finance minister, said as he left the gathering of G7 finance ministers and central bank chiefs.
"They (the G7 ministers) gave very high, very positive evaluation of the reform process which is going on in Russia."
Chubais said Russia was working on deadlines of the end of 1998 to join the World Trade Organisation and the end of 1997 to become a creditor member of the Paris Club.

"When we talk about the speeding up of the process of neglotiations for Russia joining the World Trade Organisation and when we talk about Russia joining the Paris Club as a creditor the response we get...was very positive," he said.
